channel.title: Fab OS updates
channel.description: Public release updates for Fab OS by Patience AI.

item.title: Fab OS 1.0 image, package revision 1.0-6 (16 September 2026)
item.description: Installer fixed (the package step no longer fails on a first install), automated installation now proven in a VM before publishing, quick-settings pane redesigned, dock indicators, one window shadow source, image generation from the ask bar, built-in offline model with multi-step tasks and web access, Ollama provider, enterprise security baseline. Existing installs receive 1.0-6 through Fab Updates.

item.title: Fab OS 1.0 public pre-release (14 September 2026)
item.description: The first public Fab OS 1.0 disc image: a KDE Plasma desktop on Ubuntu with the Fab agent, the ask bar, "Hey Fab" voice, a built-in offline model and a signed update channel. Download with SHA-256 checksum; pre-release software.
